title: ProT-Diff: A Modularized and Efficient Strategy for De Novo Generation of Antimicrobial Peptide Sequences by Integrating Protein Language and Diffusion Models
summary: ProT-Diff: A Modularized and Efficient Strategy for De Novo Generation of Antimicrobial Peptide Sequences by Integrating Protein Language and Diffusion Models. Generated thousands of antimicrobial peptide sequences de novo; 45 selected after physicochemical screening. 44 of 45 peptides were active against Gram-positive or Gram-negative bacteria; one peptide was effective in a drug-resistant E. coli peritonitis model. Evidence limits: Single in vivo model; pharmacology and resistance emergence not assessed. Reviewed from Europe PMC abstract only.
